title: chat-client: ChatPatch.receipt_sharing as Patch<bool> so the override can be cleared
description:
Freeze audit 2 survivor, vote 2/3.

## chat-client: ChatPatch.receipt_sharing is Option<bool>, so a client cannot remove the per-Chat receiptSharing override
Crates: jmap-chat-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:1029 `pub receipt_sharing: Option<bool>` (None = no change, Some(b) = set), and crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/chat.rs:442 emits the key only for Some. The sibling optional Chat properties in the same struct use Patch: mute_until (mod.rs:1018, Patch<&UTCDate>) and message_expiry_seconds (mod.rs:1027, Patch<u64>, documented 'Patch::Clear removes the policy server-side'). Spec draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:645-646 declares `receiptSharing (Boolean, optional)`: 'Per-Chat override of the account-level PresenceStatus.receiptSharing ... When absent, the account-level preference applies', and it is listed as an updatable patch key at :1110. The type is mirrored in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/chat.rs:245 (Option<bool>, absent = no override). Server resolution at crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:999-1029 treats an absent Chat.receiptSharing as 'fall back to the account level'. bd search receiptSharing / receipt_sharing / ChatPatch: no matching beads.
Why breaking later: ChatPatch is a pub struct with pub fields, built with struct-literal plus ..Default::default(). Changing the field type from Option<bool> to Patch<bool>, or adding a separate clear flag, breaks every caller that sets the field. Until then a client using this crate can set the override but can never go back to the spec's absent state ('account-level preference applies'); it can only pin true or false. That loses a wire value the spec allows (null in a PatchObject, per RFC 8620 §5.3).
Fix: Change ChatPatch.receipt_sharing to Patch<bool>, as already done for mute_until and message_expiry_seconds. Emit null for Patch::Clear in chat.rs, and check that the server's Chat/set update accepts null for receiptSharing by removing the stored override. PresenceStatusPatch.receipt_sharing (mod.rs:783) stays Option<bool>, because the account-level property is non-optional with default true.
Size: S
